about.label: About
timeline: Stockholm discovers hip hop. Kenny Black is there at the beginning.
Publishes "Electric Boogie: When Hip Hop Came to Sweden 1982–1988"
Founds Finest Blend Recordings — electro-funk inspired Detroit music
Establishes Soul Corner — the definitive Stockholm deep house residency
Launches DJ School — teaching the craft from vinyl up for all ages
Still going. Still vinyl. Still ahead of the curve.
bio: Kenny Black is not just a DJ — he is a chapter in Swedish music history. When hip hop arrived in Stockholm in 1982, Kenny was in the room.
As the founder of Finest Blend Recordings and author of Electric Boogie: When Hip Hop Came to Sweden, Kenny brings scholarship and soul to everything he touches.
Behind the decks, his approach is simple: vinyl first, crowd always.
His DJ School passes the knowledge forward — hands-on vinyl and digital training for beginners to advanced students of all ages.

school.label: DJ School
school.description: Kenny Black has been teaching the art of DJing for over two decades. He wrote the book on it — literally. Whether you are picking up the needle for the first time or refining your technique for the stage, this is where you begin.
school.bookDesc: "DJ Skolan — Lär dig DJa med Kenny Black" covers 12 fundamental steps: rhythm, BPM, cueing, beatmatching, looping, EQ techniques, and building complete DJ sets. Available in Swedish. Suitable for ages 10 and up.

beginner.title: Beginner
beginner.desc: No experience needed. Learn the equipment, basic mixing, music fundamentals, and the history of DJ culture.

intermediate.title: Intermediate
intermediate.desc: Beatmatching by ear, set building, EQ and transitions. Develop your own sound and programming style.

advanced.title: Advanced
advanced.desc: Professional techniques, crowd reading, and developing your artistic identity. Stage-ready performance skills.
